{{Quote|The Jundland Wastes are not to be traveled lightly.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''Hubba Heights''' was a mountainous region of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ItWoSWR" />

In the days prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="ANH" /> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] caught the fleeing droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in a [[Tusken Canyon|canyon]] at the edge of the Hubba Heights<ref name="ItWoSWR" /> after the latter escaped from the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]. They were then attacked by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] but were soon rescued by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]<ref name="ANH" /> who had his [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|home]] in the neighborhood.<ref name="ItWoSWR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The twelfth image of the article "[[Visual Guides|Visual Guide]] &mdash; Chapter 6: Lost in the Desert" identified one of the location seen in {{Film|IV}} as the Jawa Heights. Unfortunately, the individual images of the article were not available anymore.<ref name="VG">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp06.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 6: Lost in the Desert}}</ref>
